items.description: Les attaques de drones contre l'oléoduc est-ouest en Arabie saoudite et la prise de contrôle du détroit de Bab El -Manded par les rebelles houthis du Yémen renforce la pression sur le prix du pétrole. items.description: À Kobané, en Syrie, les corps de neuf détenus kurdes morts après avoir mis le feu à leurs cellules jeudi 10 septembre ont été enterrés lundi 14 septembre au soir. La ville symbole avait vu auparavant exploser des heurts à la suite de la mort d'un ancien combattant kurde, sur fond de tensions avec des tribus arabes. Ces violences interviennent au moment où le pouvoir central tente de parfaire l'intégration de ces zones kurdes à la suite d'un accord signé en janvier dernier.

items.title: Norman Foster says nuclear is key for 'Electrical Revolution'
items.summary: Architect Norman Foster says that nuclear's ability to provide a "vast amount of power" with "a tiny imprint" means that micro-modular power units should be being produced at "industrial-scale, like jet engines" with the potential to autonomously power new developments and move beyond the "obsolete idea of a grid".

items.title: Africa must be part of global nuclear renaissance, says Togolese leader
items.summary: The African continent "is not asking for a handout of nuclear technology" and should be recognised as a market for such technology, Faure Essozimna Gnassingbe, President of Togo's Council of Ministers, told World Nuclear Symposium delegates in London.

items.title: IAEA's projections suggest there could be 1,000 SMRs by 2060
items.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency has released its annual projections of future energy demands and nuclear power capacity - and suggested in its 'high case' scenario that by 2060 there could be as much as 284 GWe capacity provided by small modular reactors, which would be the equivalent of 946 SMRs if they average 300 MWe capacity, or 1,136 SMRs if they average 250 MWe.

items.title: Siemens Energy to produce Rolls-Royce SMR turbines in the UK
items.summary: Key steam turbine components - including high-pressure turbines and valve casings - for Rolls-Royce SMR's first three small modular reactors at the Gwyndod project on Anglesey in North Wales, will be manufactured at Germany-based Siemens Energy's facility in Newcastle, in northeast England.

items.title: US maritime nuclear energy company raises USD50 million
items.summary: Bluecore Energy, a developer of small modular, water-cooled reactors designed to operate aboard floating barges, has announced the close of a USD50 million seed financing to accelerate development, testing, and deployment of its floating nuclear energy systems.

items.title: US Department of Energy closes loan for Duane Arnold restart
items.summary: The US Department of Energy's Office of Energy Dominance Financing has closed a loan of up to USD1.9 billion to NextEra Energy to help finance the restart of the Duane Arnold Energy Center, taking the company closer to bringing Iowa's only nuclear power plant back into operation.
